links.comparator_used: No notification (control physicians received no email or page about high-risk patients; usual care)
links.outcome: ACP conversation documented in the EHR by the randomized physician during admission (primary outcome)
links.effect: 34.7% vs. 19.6%; OR 2.04; 95% CI 1.16-3.59. ACP documentation by any clinician (secondary) did not differ significantly: 52.8% vs. 42.8%, OR 1.31; 95% CI 0.81-2.13.
links.quote: Patients of physicians randomized to the intervention group were more likely to have a documented ACP conversation by the randomized physician compared to the control group (34.7% vs. 19.6%; OR 2.04; 95% CI 1.16-3.59).

design_hint: Machine learning mortality risk notifications (email/page alerts) to physicians prompting ACP documentation
